blocks.text: Heavy rain and flooding across Bangkok prompted shoppers to stock up on food and essentials, leaving some convenience-store shelves empty as authorities moved to replenish supplies. Heavy rain and widespread flooding across Bangkok have prompted residents to stock up on food and essential goods, leaving shelves empty at some convenience stores and neighbourhood shops amid concerns over travel disruption and possible shortages. Thansettakij surveyed shopping conditions in Bangkok after continuous rain from the early hours of Friday (September 25) lasted for more than 30 hours, causing flooding in several areas awaiting drainage.
